sentences.text: Mr S. V. Sirpurkar, Advocate for Petitioner.

Mr V. A. Thakare, App for Respondent Nos.1 to 3.
 Coram : Vinay Joshi And Valmiki Sa Menezes, Jj.
It is unfortunate that despite judicial order of learned Magistrate, the petitioner is required to approach this Court just to see the compliance of the said order.

The petitioner has filed an application under Section 156(3) of the Code to the Judicial Magistrate First Class, Chamorshi,
District Gadchiroli seeking directions against the concerned Police to register an offence under various Sections of the Indian Penal Code.
Having been found prima facie case about commission of cognizable offences, the Magistrate vide reasoned order dated 20.05.2023 has directed the concerned PSO to register the offence and investigate.

The said order is reproduced as under :
"1] Police Station Officer (PSO) of Chamorshi police station is hereby directed to register and investigate the offence against accused Rajesh D Khandve u/s 294, 324,
326 and 342 of IPC vide section 156(3) of CrPC, and to make the further proceeding as per Chapter 12 of Cr.P.C.
TAMBE Atul S/O. Gangadharao Ganyarpawar vs State Of Mah. Thr. Home Ministry, ... on 20 June, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/78172939/
1  6 Cr. WP-420-2023  2] Copy of the complaint (Exh.1) in RCC No.31/2023 be sent to the concerned police station, the complaint be registered as an FIR for above mentioned offence."
3. It is the petitioner's grievance that despite such directions, the Police are not registering the offence.

entities.text: TAMBE Atul S/O. Gangadharao Ganyarpawar vs State Of Mah. Thr. Home Ministry
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
Learned Advocate Mr Sirpurkar has informed that the Police are biased because after passing of such order by the learned Magistrate, the PSO got annoyed, and therefore, has assaulted the Magistrate at his residence.
4.

Be that as it may, however, by all means, when the Magistrate has specifically directed the Police to register an offence by passing judicial order, the Police have no choice to stay away, unless the order is altered, modified or revoked by the Court of law.
Particularly, on the background about the assault on judicial officer, that may not be the reason for not obeying the order.
5. We request learned APP to seek instructions as to why the offence is not registered.
Failing which in absence of convincing reasons, we would take the serious view against the concerned erring police officers.
Learned APP shall revert us on tomorrow i.e. on 21.06.2023.
6. Authenticated copy of this order be given to the learned APP.
TAMBE Atul S/O. Gangadharao Ganyarpawar vs State Of Mah. Thr. Home Ministry, ...
